name: builder
description: Builds a site for Publish. For now it turns a folder of ready files into a build, with no command run; building from a repo or running a build command needs a container builder this server does not have yet.

settings.label: Publish apps that run their own server
settings.help: Off in this test release. On lets Publish build a folder with a Dockerfile and run it as a server. It stays off until the server's build network and its Space-and-name keying have been reviewed.
